name: @orbb/measurement
description: Measurement engine core for ORBB (M4-A Lane A): metric catalog with versioned supersession (A27), method registry + deny-by-default capability index (A28), deterministic protocol plan compiler (A29), idempotent task scheduler with UTC window math and missed-window roll-forward (A30), attempt recorder with completion quality states and method fallback (A31), and same-metric multi-source reconciliation into one canonical observation view with per-source provenance (M4 exit proof).
